title: Wonderful!
text: This tour is absolutely wonderful! You should triple check, however, that you booked the one with all the Alhambra tickets included. Our main guide Fouad, Alhambra guide  Consuela, and the driver Manuel were amazing. They were super knowledgeable, supportive, and understanding. I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. Just make sure you reserve your full day for this.
author: o_o

title: A must-do!
text:
Long day, but it's really worth it!
Visit to the Albaicin with our guide Catherine, who was competent and very pleasant. Lookout with a breathtaking view of the Alhambra and the Sierra. Visit to the Alhambra with a fascinating guide, who accompanied us for 3 hours: it was breathtakingly beautiful and historically exceptional.
author: Paradise30205448722

title: Alhambra tour
text:
The Alhambra was breathtaking! So much of history and beauty to be found there. Our tour guide, Antonio was very knowledgeable.
He was also very helpful when one of our party had to return to the Wecome center via taxi that got him lost. Antonio used my phone to speak to the second taxi driver and directed him safely back to us.
author: MAUREEN_D

title: An unforgettable day trip to Granada and the Alhambra from Seville!
text:
Our day trip from Seville to Granada was absolutely wonderful. The Alhambra was breathtaking, with its incredible Moorish architecture, intricate carvings, peaceful courtyards, and beautiful gardens. Every corner revealed something remarkable, and the views of Granada were spectacular.
Granada itself was charming, with its historic streets, lively atmosphere, and rich Andalusian culture. Although it was a long day, the journey was well worth it. Having the opportunity to experience one of Spain’s most extraordinary historical landmarks in a single trip was truly special.

title: Cannot visit Granada without seeing the Alhambra!
text: A fantastic site to visit.  Book early and hope for good weather and a lot of walking.  Be sure not to touch any vegetation and always stay on approved paths!

title: A very beautiful day.
text: A very beautiful day with lots of interesting information and explanations. Thanks to the bus guides and the on-site tour guides, they are very competent and kind.

title: Amazing tour!
text: We enjoyed this tour! Beautiful drive, long day but worth it. Pia was our tour guide. She was great! Such wonderful information she shared and great English! I would highly recommend!

title: This was a brilliant trip...
text:
This was a brilliant trip which made the long journey from Seville worthwhile although it was disappointing that the trip started several hours later than planned as we would have preferred more time in Granada itself. 
Initially the guide on the coach couldn’t be understood despite talking in English but once we swopped to the official  guide in Granada the tour was superb. He really made the history of the place come alive. 
Take a packed lunch with you as there isn’t time to visit a restaurant.
